import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 25;
    static final int INF = 10007;
    static final int MAXT = 65;
    static final int MAXC = 12;

    static int n, k;
    static String[] A, B;
    static int[][] distB = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][][][][] reach = new int[MAXT][MAXC][MAXC][MAXC][MAXC];
    static int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static ArrayList<int[]> sourceSet = new ArrayList<>();
    static ArrayList<int[]> sinkSet = new ArrayList<>();

    static class EdmondsKarp {
        int n;
        int[][] cap;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> adj;

        EdmondsKarp(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            cap = new int[n][n];
            adj = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int w) {
            if (cap[u][v] == 0 && cap[v][u] == 0) {
                adj.get(u).add(v);
                adj.get(v).add(u);
            }
            cap[u][v] += w;
        }

        int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            int flow = 0;
            while (true) {
                int[] parent = new int[n];
                Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
                parent[s] = s;
                Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
                q.add(s);
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    int u = q.poll();
                    if (u == t) break;
                    for (int v : adj.get(u)) {
                        if (parent[v] == -1 && cap[u][v] > 0) {
                            parent[v] = u;
                            q.add(v);
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (parent[t] == -1) break;
                int f = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                    f = Math.min(f, cap[parent[v]][v]);
                }
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                    cap[parent[v]][v] -= f;
                    cap[v][parent[v]] += f;
                }
                flow += f;
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static void bfsFromZ(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(distB[i], -1);
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        distB[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[d];
                int ny = y + dy[d];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= n || ny < 0 || ny >= n) continue;
                if (distB[nx][ny] != -1) continue;
                if (B[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Y' || B[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Z') continue;
                distB[nx][ny] = distB[x][y] + 1;
                q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
            }
        }
    }

    static void buildDP() {
        for (int t = k; t >= 0; t--) {
            for (int x0 = 0; x0 < n; x0++) {
                for (int y0 = 0; y0 < n; y0++) {
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
                        for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                            int res;
                            if (distB[x0][y0] < t) res = 0;
                            else if (x0 == x && y0 == y) res = 1;
                            else if (t >= k) res = 0;
                            else if (distB[x0][y0] <= t) res = 0;
                            else {
                                res = 0;
                                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                                    int nx = x0 + dx[d];
                                    int ny = y0 + dy[d];
                                    if (nx < 0 || nx >= n || ny < 0 || ny >= n) continue;
                                    if (A[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Y' || A[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Z') continue;
                                    if (reach[t + 1][nx][ny][x][y] == 1) {
                                        res = 1;
                                        break;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            reach[t][x0][y0][x][y] = res;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        A = new String[n];
        B = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) A[i] = sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) B[i] = sc.nextLine();

        int zx = -1, zy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (B[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    zx = i;
                    zy = j;
                }
            }
        }

        bfsFromZ(zx, zy);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (distB[i][j] == -1) distB[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = A[i].charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Z' && c != 'Y' && c != '0') sourceSet.add(new int[]{i, j});
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = B[i].charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Z' && c != 'Y' && c != '0') sinkSet.add(new int[]{i, j});
            }
        }

        buildDP();

        int S = 0;
        int T = sourceSet.size() + sinkSet.size() + 1;
        EdmondsKarp ek = new EdmondsKarp(T + 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < sourceSet.size(); i++) {
            int[] p = sourceSet.get(i);
            ek.addEdge(S, i + 1, A[p[0]].charAt(p[1]) - '0');
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < sinkSet.size(); i++) {
            int[] p = sinkSet.get(i);
            ek.addEdge(sourceSet.size() + i + 1, T, B[p[0]].charAt(p[1]) - '0');
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < sourceSet.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < sinkSet.size(); j++) {
                int[] src = sourceSet.get(i);
                int[] snk = sinkSet.get(j);
                if (reach[0][src[0]][src[1]][snk[0]][snk[1]] == 1) {
                    ek.addEdge(i + 1, sourceSet.size() + j + 1, INF);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(ek.maxFlow(S, T));
        sc.close();
    }
}
